title: Two-tag Praxis with one published tag direction
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5537 MiB (5.4063 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 26426 million field multiplications (14783 and 11643), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
